name: OmaTaskNotes
author: Doghouse-Mike
description: Obsidian TaskNotes tasks from a local vault, in the Omarchy bar

barWidget.description: Counts open TaskNotes tasks for a chosen TaskNotes view and lists them in a popup, with click-to-complete and quick add. Reads the vault directly, so anything that syncs it keeps this current.

schema.label: Vault path
schema.description: Folder containing the Obsidian vault. Left empty, the vault Obsidian currently has open is used.

schema.label: TaskNotes view
schema.description: Which TaskNotes view to show, e.g. "base:TaskNotes/Views/tasks-default.base::Today". Usually set from the popup's view picker rather than typed here.

schema.label: Bar icon lights up for
schema.description: all keeps the icon lit whenever the current view has any open task; due lights it only for tasks due today or earlier.

schema.label: Rescan interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the vault is rescanned. The popup also rescans every time it opens.

schema.label: Read-only task view
schema.description: Open tasks in Obsidian instead of changing notes. Keeps native recurrence, calendar and sync behavior in TaskNotes.
